info.name: pencil
info.label: Pencil / Graphite
info.description: Coloured-pencil lines on paper: stamped, grainy, with a light-firm-light pressure profile. Areas shaded with close parallel strokes.

info.name: ink
info.label: Ink Brush
info.description: A loaded ink brush: strokes swell and taper, tails breaking into dry streaks. Filled areas pool denser at the rim with a ragged feathered edge.

info.name: watercolor
info.label: Watercolor
info.description: Transparent glazes that wander, fractal-edged outlines from stacked washes, granulation, and a wet bead of pigment at the tip and rim.

info.name: oil
info.label: Oil / Acrylic
info.description: A loaded bristles brush in thick, glossy oil paint — both colours side by side, ridges from every bristle, the end running dry. Acrylic mode gives flatter, streaky paint.

info.name: graffiti
info.label: Graffiti / Spray
info.description: Particle-spray: soft overspray haze, a dense particle body, speckles flying off, and occasional drips on heavy strokes.

info.name: graphic
info.label: Flat Graphic
info.description: Clean flat shapes with bold colours and strong contrast. Supports halftone dots, bokeh glow, and geometric reduction sub-modes.

info.name: charcoal
info.label: Charcoal
info.description: Heavy grain, soft edges, smudgy look. Stamped brush with a firm-middle / very-light-at-ends pressure profile, rendered in multiple overlapping passes with decreasing opacity. Uses charcoal grey tones sampled from the source.

info.name: marker
info.label: Alcohol Marker
info.description: Alcohol marker with a chisel tip at 45°. Transparent ink that darkens where strokes overlap. Clean edges, no grain. A soft blot appears where the pen rests at the end of a stroke.

info.name: calligraphy
info.label: Calligraphy
info.description: Broad-nib calligraphy with pressure-sensitive ribbon strokes. Wide on downstrokes, thin on upstrokes. A 40° chisel nib creates a linear gradient along the stroke, with ink pooled at both ends as dark elliptical drops.

info.name: cross-hatch
info.label: Cross-hatch
info.description: Parallel lines at ±45° forming a cross-hatch pattern. Multiple layers of hatching at different angles are drawn as stamped brush strokes clipped to the shape, building up tonal density where lines cross.

info.name: mosaic
info.label: Mosaic
info.description: Grid-based square tiles with dark grout between them. Each tile is filled with a gradient sampled from the source colour, with slight variation per tile and random rotation for an organic, hand-set-tile look.

info.name: scribble
info.label: Scribble
info.description: Chaotic overlapping strokes within shapes. A pen goes back and forth at random angles, clipped to the shape boundary, with multiple passes building up density.

info.name: halftone
info.label: Halftone
info.description: Comic-book Ben-Day dots on a 45° screen. Dot radius varies with luminance — light areas produce small or no dots, dark areas produce large dots. Multiple colour layers create the classic halftone printing effect.

info.name: string
info.label: String Art
info.description: String art: long straight lines connecting points on a grid, following colour gradients from c0 to c1. Thin threads clipped to the shape boundary create a woven, gradient-thread effect.

info.name: sumi
info.label: Sumi Ink
info.description: Bold wet sumi-e ink: loaded brush strokes that swell in the middle and taper to a point at each end. Low-alpha layering lets dense regions build up naturally through overlap, with a subtle wet-bleed softness at the edges.

info.name: gouache
info.label: Gouache
info.description: Opaque matte gouache paint: flat colour fill with a subtle darker edge. Fully covers what is beneath — no transparency or bleed. A thin darker rim gives the soft edge of a brush loaded with pigment.

info.name: knife
info.label: Palette Knife
info.description: Palette knife: broad flat strokes with hard edges and a light ridge highlight suggesting impasto paint. The fill is opaque and flat, with a highlight band along one side of each stroke.

info.name: pastel
info.label: Pastel
info.description: Soft pastel: chalky powder with grain, light speckle, and soft blended edges. Dry-medium texture — pigment sits on the paper surface rather than flowing.

info.name: pen
info.label: Pen
info.description: Technical pen: thin crisp constant-width lines with perfectly clean edges, no grain or scatter. Area fills are rendered as outline + parallel cross-hatch lines at a fixed angle, like a drafting pen on Bristol board.

info.name: wash
info.label: Wash
info.description: Wash: very translucent broad color with soft feathered edges. Overlap darkens naturally — each pass deposits a thin layer of diluted pigment, building up density where strokes cross.

info.name: dots
info.label: Dots
info.description: Stipple / Ben-Day dots: small round dots with hard edges, placed on a grid with subtle radius and colour jitter. Dot size varies with local tone — darker areas get larger dots.

info.name: confetti
info.label: Confetti
info.description: Confetti: small rotated rectangles and triangles, opaque, with random orientation and colour variation between c0 and c1. Like party streamers scattered across the canvas.

info.name: hylics
info.label: Hylics
info.description: Claymation look: lumpy rounded blobs with wobbly edges, muted clay colors, soft shading, and a gentle drop shadow. Strokes are fat ribbons with uneven width and a matte surface.

info.name: linocut
info.label: Linocut
info.description: Linocut print: bold carved shapes with high contrast, rough chipped edges, and a limited palette of solid ink tones.

info.name: riso
info.label: Riso
info.description: Risograph: 2-3 flat spot-color inks with slight misregistration offset and paper grain texture. Each ink pass is solid and opaque, shifted slightly to create a characteristic fringe.

info.name: tape
info.label: Tape
info.description: Tape: flat opaque strips with hard straight edges and a slight sheen highlight. Clean cuts, uniform width, matte base with a glossy stripe.

info.name: thread
info.label: Thread
info.description: Thread: thin continuous wound lines with visible stitch direction and slight fuzz. Uniform-width matte strands with a subtle directional sheen and fiber texture.

info.name: stitch
info.label: Stitch
info.description: Cross-stitch: regular X-stitch marks on a grid, blocky, with limited colors. Each stitch is two diagonal lines forming an X, laid out in a fabric-like grid pattern.

info.name: neon
info.label: Neon
info.description: Neon: bright glowing tube lines with a bright core and a soft outer glow halo. The glow is built from layered blurred strokes — wide and diffuse underneath, sharp and bright on top.

info.name: bokeh
info.label: Bokeh
info.description: Bokeh: large soft translucent overlapping circles with bright rims. Each circle has a radial gradient that is bright at the center, translucent in the middle ring, and bright again at the edge — like out-of-focus point light sources.

info.name: paper
info.label: Paper
info.description: Torn paper collage: flat opaque shapes with a deckle edge and a subtle drop shadow. Each shape looks like a torn piece of paper sitting on the canvas.

info.name: glitch
info.label: Glitch
info.description: Digital glitch: RGB channel-split blocks with horizontal displacement slices and hard edges. Each channel is drawn with a small random offset, creating a color-fringe datamosh effect.

info.name: frost
info.label: Frost
info.description: Frost: icy crystalline speckle in pale blues and whites. Sharp small shards radiate from edges with translucent glinting highlights and a field of frost crystals.

info.name: embroid
info.label: Embroidery
info.description: Embroidery: dense parallel satin-stitch bands filling the shape. Each stitch is a short glossy segment running along the gradient axis, with a border to complete the embroidered patch look.

info.name: plast
info.label: Plastic
info.description: Plastic: glossy molded plastic with a flat base fill and a bright specular highlight streak. A reflective rim and soft shadow give the curved-surface plastic look.

info.name: ceramic
info.label: Ceramic
info.description: Glazed porcelain ropes with a lacquer highlight, ends that drop to a point. Lit in 3D with glossy reflections.

info.name: stone
info.label: Stone
info.description: Lines that fuse into one rock, matte, with procedural grain on the lit slopes. Lit in 3D with soft shadows.

info.name: metal
info.label: Metal
info.description: Polished kinetic metal — the picture colours as shadow, midtone, and highlight with sharp specular reflections. Lit in 3D.

info.name: chrome
info.label: Chrome
info.description: Liquid chrome ropes that melt together, reflecting a studio environment with fine surface grain. Lit in 3D with environment reflections.

info.name: glass
info.label: Glass
info.description: Clear rippled glass that bends what lies beneath it, with a bevelled rim, bright glint, and environment reflections. Lit in 3D with refraction.

info.name: lens
info.label: Lens
info.description: A clear lens that magnifies what lies beneath, with a dome cross-section, Fresnel reflections, and light-gathering. Lit in 3D with refraction.

info.name: crystal
info.label: Crystal
info.description: Cut crystal with flat facets that each bend what lies beneath, featuring dispersion, sharp glints, and random sparkle. Lit in 3D with refraction.

info.name: gold
info.label: Gold
info.description: Rough gold-leaf ropes — flakes laid side by side, each tilted its own way, with dark cracks between them. Lit in 3D with reflections.

info.name: bronze
info.label: Bronze
info.description: Dark cast bronze with green patina in the hollows and polished golden-brown on the high points. Lit in 3D.

info.name: copper
info.label: Copper
info.description: Rough copper ropes with green verdigris in the hollows and polished warm bronze where it catches the light. Lit in 3D.

info.name: pewter
info.label: Pewter
info.description: Rough granular dark metal with brushed texture — anisotropic highlights drawn out along the stroke direction. Lit in 3D.

info.name: foam
info.label: Foam
info.description: A heap of soft, bulbous foam beads lying in layers, casting shadows on each other. Lit in 3D with soft wrapped lighting.

info.name: beads
info.label: Beads
info.description: Chains of glossy lacquered beads laid along the stroke, each catching the light with a sharp specular highlight. Lit in 3D.

info.name: puffy
info.label: Puffy
info.description: Inflated glossy vinyl ropes — soft, puffed-up profile with a glossy sheen and rim reflections. Lit in 3D.

info.name: terrazzo
info.label: Terrazzo
info.description: Polished terrazzo with chips of stone set in a binder — each stroke becomes a textured slab with light and dark chips. Lit in 3D.

info.name: molten
info.label: Molten
info.description: Liquid metal ropes that melt together into a glowing mass, reflecting a studio with fine surface grain. Lit in 3D with reflections.
